reviews.x: I am so happy that I stumbled upon these amazing wipes! One day I went to Ulta for micellar wipes, walked out with everything BUT wipes... so I started searching Amazon. I saw these had good reviews relating to quality, plus you get 150 for the price of 80 or less at a brick and mortar store! I figured for $15 I didn’t have anything to lose. Now I hope they never stop selling them!!  These have the nicest texture and they are thick! I love that when I’m taking my makeup off they don’t pull apart

reviews.t: Great for sensitive skin and awesome for the price!
reviews.x: I have extremely sensitive skin, and even the name brand sensitive makeup remover wipes cause some irritation. After reading positive reviews for these wipes I was skeptical but these exceed my expectations. They really take off every bit of makeup and mascara without having to rub or use multiple wipes. I also like that they have a true cover to keep them moist. I took a pack on a 21 day vacation and they never dried out.

reviews.t: They are free or hatch chemicals! And they work great, even for sensitive skin type.
reviews.x: I love how inexpensive these wipes are. I was surprised honestly lol and seriously had everything I was looking for and MORE! The wipes don’t dry your skin! Durable material! And Hydrating!  I highly recommend, everyday use/travel/ Busy Parents.

reviews.t: Nice for a lazy girl, leaves a bit of a residue.
reviews.x: These do a good job of removing makeup, but leave my face feeling kind of sticky. It's not exactly pleasant, but it's better than waking up with raccoon eyes if I'm too lazy to wash my face at night.

These wipes do everything I need it to! Removes all makeup without leaving a soapy/greasy residue and leaves my skin feeling refreshed, soft and moisturized. They smell great but aren't harmful to your eyes and are gentle enough for everyday use. I have sensitive skin and this cloth is a lot softer than others and doesn't irritate my skin in any way. LOVE the stay fresh lid which keeps your wipes from drying out. Definitely worth the buy!

These are so nice!!! Great for travel and they cleaned up all my makeup off including waterproof mascara. I originally bought them to clean up or wipe during makeup application but I used them on a whim on my face. Really worked. Small sheet but packs a punch. Lightly scented and did not burn my sensitive eyes. The price is great for such a wonderful product. Will repurchase.

reviews.t: Good product. Packaging however is subpar
reviews.x: These do a good job of removing makeup and I think my skin is cleaner with these than with previous ones I've used! HOWEVER the second time I ordered these one of the packages was ripped and all the wipes dried out. This is not acceptable.  I will try ordering them again though.

reviews.t: This is such a good deal, I love the price and convenient
reviews.x: This is such a good deal, I love the price and convenient. However, it does not do as good as the Pond cold cream to remove mascara. I still love it thought but still keep my Pond cream for extra cleaning.

reviews.t: work great to take off makeup
reviews.x: work great to take off makeup, only one wipe needed per time, not the best for sensitive skin (can cause some redness) but does its job and feels nice after

reviews.t: Perfect for on the go or at home to remove ...
reviews.x: Perfect for on the go or at home to remove all your make up with one wipe. Soft to the skin and smells great 👍🏽 I have sensitive skin and always worried about using new products but these makeup removers has worked so well for me. Definitely my go to wipes

I was amazed to get micellar wipes at the price per package, and I am pleased with the quality. The wipes are sturdy, and there is a very faint, pleasant scent to them. I am also pleased to buy a product made in the USA. Will purchase again!
I like that there is no residue to rinse off, it's a different kind of texture than I am used to, but it does great getting the make up off

reviews.t: It was a painful process attempting to remove makeup
reviews.x: Unfortunately this does not remove waterproof eyeliner or mascara. It was a painful process attempting to remove makeup :/

Found these or something like these at TJ Maxx and then couldn't find anymore so ordered from Amazon. They work great to lift makeup but I dont like the film or bitter taste they leave on the skin that I can taste if I lick my lips. So to resolve this issue,  I splash my face with water and then wipe with cloth after I use the wipes. I have not had any breakouts, rashes or other allergic reaction while using these. Great quantity for the money too.

Wonderful Product!! It removes makeup so well compared to other wipes I've used in the past. These wipes leave my face feeling so soft and has been great for my sensitive skin. Definitely will be a returning customer.

reviews.t: This product is amazing! Very gentle on your skin but gets all ...
reviews.x: This product is amazing! Very gentle on your skin but gets all the makeup off. Much better than other brands with similar products (cough-cough-Neutregena). I recommend this product to everyone!
These are the best wipes ever created! Leaves mine and my family's faces feeling extra soft without the sticky residue left behind. We have no complaints! Highly recommend to anyone :)
Love these wipes!! my whole family loves them and uses them all the time!!! Great quality for an affordable price.
Nice fragrance, removed makeup well, like size- easy to pack!
These are amazing! Will definitely be buying these again.
Very nice face cleaning cloths in convenient packs.
These are the best make up wipes I’ve ever used.
Ok for the price, wouldn’t be my top pick

I was skeptical because of the price and I've always used Neutrogena wipes and they have always worked great. But these were so much cheaper with good reviews that I thought I would give them a try and I love them! They take the makeup off (eyeliner, mascara, foundation, lipstick - all of it) and leaves my face feeling softer and more moisturized than any other wipes I've used.

After my daughter started using these, she noticed that her skin was breaking out. Once she discontinued using them her skin started to improve.  They seem to leave a film on the skin which is likely the cause.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise these wipes for effectively removing makeup, including mascara, often with just one wipe.
Many customers highlight the great value and low price, noting the large quantity for the cost.
Several reviewers with sensitive skin report the wipes are gentle and non-irritating, though a couple mention redness or irritation.
Some customers note a sticky or filmy residue left on the skin after use.
A few reviewers report issues with packaging (ripped package causing dried-out wipes) or failure to remove waterproof eyeliner/mascara.
